{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|To celebrate the Imperial victory!|Nereus|<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>}}
'''Namana nectar''' was made from the [[Namana]] fruit and was an extremely strong tasting concoction that had the potency of a strong alcoholic beverage. [[Wilek Nereus]] used to the Namana nectar to make a toast.
